say:0:1029734001:0.text: You go over the full timeline, the suspects, and everything you uncovered during the questioning.
say:0:1029734001:0.source_cn: 你们把理清的时间线，嫌疑对象，以及所有的审讯结果都告诉...

say:1:1029734002:0.text: Sonja, having heard the commotion, arrives and listens in with Lucca.
say:1:1029734002:0.source_cn: 闻讯而来的索尼娅也与卢卡一道听了事情的来龙去脉。

say:4:1029734003:1.text: Sounds like the mastermind got my travel details from the Holistone docks.
say:4:1029734003:1.source_cn: 看起来，这个幕后黑手应该是从圣石镇那边的码头得知我的出...

say:5:1029734004:1.text: It's probably someone inside the Mithril Consortium. I think it ties back to the audit I ran recently... which is actually a good thing.
say:5:1029734004:1.source_cn: 应该是秘银商会内部的人，我想，多半与我之前的查账有关系...

say:6:1029734005:1.text: How is that a good thing, Rowan?! Someone literally tried to have you killed!
say:6:1029734005:1.source_cn: 这怎么是好事呀，罗万！他都直接买凶要干掉你了！

say:7:1029734006:1.text: Yes, but I was more worried that my trade route plan had stepped on too many toes.
say:7:1029734006:1.source_cn: 嗯，我原本担心是我想要整合商路的计划动到了其他人的蛋糕。

say:8:1029734007:1.text: If that were the case, it'd be easier to sabotage the plan itself, not go after me directly.
say:8:1029734007:1.source_cn: 如果是那样的话，比起袭击我这个人，去破坏我的计划想必会...

say:9:1029734008:1.text: They could've tampered with goods, botched orders, or even ambushed the transport routes—which would affect the whole operation.
say:9:1029734008:1.source_cn: 比如说在货物和订单上做手脚，又或者是袭击运货路线——那...

say:10:1029734009:1.text: You are truly bold and profit-driven...
say:10:1029734009:1.source_cn: 这还真是，利益至上的勇气啊……

say:11:1029734010:0.text: Luckily, my audit only focused on a small circle. We can narrow down the suspects one by one, and I already have a plan for that.
say:11:1029734010:0.source_cn: 而且更好的是，我这次查账针对的人很有限，慢慢排查即可，...

say:12:1029734011:1.text: Once we get the Rustport trade station up and running, I can put it into action.
say:12:1029734011:1.source_cn: 等到建立起锈锚港的贸易站之后，我们就可以实行计划了。

say:15:1029734012:1.text: Speaking of the trade station, we do have some concerns.
say:15:1029734012:1.source_cn: 说到贸易站，我们也有一些担忧。

say:16:1029734013:1.text: I've listed all the resources we can provide: ships, routes, sailors, dockhands, porters. That's all handled.
say:16:1029734013:1.source_cn: 刚刚我已经整理了我们能够提供的所有资源，船只、航线、水...

say:17:1029734014:1.text: But when it comes to the goods themselves, we're seriously lacking in both experience and manpower.
say:17:1029734014:1.source_cn: 但是对于商贸所需的商品，包装和质量上，我们这边实在没有...

say:18:1029734015:1.text: Sorting, grading, packaging, pricing—these are all major hurdles for us...
say:18:1029734015:1.source_cn: 筛选、评级、包装甚至定价，对我们来说都是难题……

choice_prompt:19:1029734015.text: Sorting, grading, packaging, pricing—these are all major hurdles for us...
choice_prompt:19:1029734015.source_cn: 筛选、评级、包装甚至定价，对我们来说都是难题……

say:20:1029734016:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right. Our side is well-equipped to manage goods, logistics, and orders.
say:20:1029734016:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right. Our side is well-equipped to manage goods, logistics, and orders.
say:20:1029734016:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right. Our side is well-equipped to manage goods, logistics, and orders.

say:21:1029734017:1.text: Plus, we can help with training and provide a structured support system—especially for finance and trade.
say:21:1029734017:1.source_cn: 此外，也能为贵方提供人才支援和成体系的培训——当然，主...

say:22:1029734018:1.text: Meanwhile, your team can focus on supply, storage, and shipping at the start. Over time, we can gradually scale that down.
say:22:1029734018:1.source_cn: 而贵方可以在初期先保障供货、仓储以及运输，随着我们合作...

say:23:1029734019:1.text: We deeply appreciate your sincerity. I'll skip the formalities—let's work on this together as soon as we can.
say:23:1029734019:1.source_cn: 贵方的诚意我深表感谢，在这里就不多做客套了，我们会尽快...

say:24:1029734020:1.text: As for the first shipment... Sinbad, think you can handle it?
say:24:1029734020:1.source_cn: 嗯，至于最初期的运输，就交给……辛巴达，你能行吗？

say:27:1029734021:1.text: Me?! Wait a sec, my ship's not made for hauling cargo!
say:27:1029734021:1.source_cn: 我？！不对吧！我的船可不是用来拉货的！

say:28:1029734022:1.text: But your ship is faster and more stable.
say:28:1029734022:1.source_cn: 但你的船速度更快，也更平稳。

say:29:1029734023:1.text: B-but I'm supposed to be a legendary adventurer, not a delivery guy...
say:29:1029734023:1.source_cn: 可，可我想当的是了不起的冒险家，航海家，当商船可就……

choice_prompt:30:1029734023.text: B-but I'm supposed to be a legendary adventurer, not a delivery guy...
choice_prompt:30:1029734023.source_cn: 可，可我想当的是了不起的冒险家，航海家，当商船可就……

say:31:1029734024:1.text: Well... since you're asking so nicely... fine. I'll do it, for you!
say:31:1029734024:1.source_cn: 既然你都这么恳求我了……算了，看在你的面子上！
say:31:1029734024:1.male: Well... since you're asking so nicely... fine. I'll do it, for you!
say:31:1029734024:1.female: Well... since you're asking so nicely... fine. I'll do it, for you!

say:32:1029734026:1.text: Just remember, your ship will carry the trust of both Rustport and the Mithril Consortium. Don't get too relaxed.
say:32:1029734026:1.source_cn: 运输期间，你的船承担着秘银商会和锈锚港双重的信任，不要...

say:33:1029734027:1.text: Don't worry, I'm not that clueless rookie anymore. I'm a real captain now!
say:33:1029734027:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我又不是以前那个毛头小子了，我现在可是了不起的...

say:34:1029734028:1.text: And hey, with Rustport's name and the Consortium's cargo on board... maybe I'll get to fight off pirates too?
say:34:1029734028:1.source_cn: 嗯……这样一想，我打着锈锚港的旗号，还载着秘银商会的货...

say:35:1029734029:1.text: Even as a cargo run, it might still be an adventure!
say:35:1029734029:1.source_cn: 就算当商船，估计也会有不少乐趣！

say:36:1029734030:1.text:

Forget it. Alright, we'll leave it to you. Make sure you set sail on time.
say:36:1029734030:1.source_cn: …………\n算了，就交给你吧，记得按时起航。

say:38:1029734031:1.text: I was about to give him a lecture, but scolding him feels pointless. He always comes through when it counts. Let's leave it at that.
say:38:1029734031:1.source_cn: 本来想数落他一顿，但感觉说了也没用，更何况辛巴达关键时...

say:39:1029734033:1.text: You know... it's been a while since our last life-or-death adventure together.
say:39:1029734033:1.source_cn: 这样想来，距我们此前共同出生入死的冒险，也已经过了一段...

say:40:1029734034:1.text: Back then, I never would've guessed Rustport would end up like this...
say:40:1029734034:1.source_cn: 那时完全想不到，锈锚港会变成现在这样啊……

say:41:1029734035:1.text: As Sonja reminisces, you notice a brilliant flash of light flicker within your bag...
say:41:1029734035:1.source_cn: 在索尼娅发出感慨的时候，你突然注意到，包裹里闪过了一丝...
say:41:1029734035:1.male: As Sonja reminisces, you notice a brilliant flash of light flicker within your bag...
say:41:1029734035:1.female: As Sonja reminisces, you notice a brilliant flash of light flicker within your bag...

say:46:1029734037:1.text: It's even brighter than last time!
say:46:1029734037:1.source_cn: 这次比上次又亮了一些！

choice_prompt:47:1029734037.text: It's even brighter than last time!
choice_prompt:47:1029734037.source_cn: 这次比上次又亮了一些！

say:48:1029734038:1.text: I knew it! We went through so much together—shipwrecks, the Carmine Whispers, the Water Wights, the Dead Tide Fleet...
say:48:1029734038:1.source_cn: 果然如此！我们在这里经历过很长一段冒险的时光，海难，血...

say:51:1029734040:1.text: Then let's help Rowan finish things in Rustport as quickly as we can!
say:51:1029734040:1.source_cn: 那我们就快点帮罗万把锈锚港这里搞定吧！

say:54:1029734041:1.male: Right! Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's build that trade station together.
say:54:1029734041:1.female: Right! Come on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's build that trade station together.

say:57:1029734032:1.source_cn: 感觉说了也是白费口舌，而且他在关键时刻也算可靠，算了吧。
